title: bouteloua hirsuta subsp. pectinata
intro: Bouteloua hirsuta subsp. pectinata, commonly known as silver grama, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that can help soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Bouteloua hirsuta subsp. pectinata include antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, making it a potential treatment for various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and offer protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
